g.text: Starts the process: uploads the RUT (optional
AI extraction) and fills the risk matrix
Computes the risk tier and emails the supplier
a form link valid for 30 days
Confirms the document number, fills the
Tier by evaluation type (low · medium · high):
approves, or rejects with internal and external reasons
Creates the supplier in the accounting
re-uploads it with the same link
Management can return the process to any completed phase (the right link is
re-sent) or annul it; every rejection and return is kept in the audit trail
